title: Research
text: My research sits at the intersection of computational neuroscience and machine learning. I investigate how intelligent systems—both biological and artificial—generalize from experience in partially observable environments.

title: Research
text:
Cognitive Gridworld
I developed Cognitive Gridworld, an open-source framework for investigating how agents learn the compositional structure of the world from naturalistic feedback.
Resources: GitHub Repository

title: Research
text:
Representation Classification Chains (RCC)
I designed the Representation Classification Chains architecture, which tackles continual meta-learning as a variational-inference problem. The key insight was to seperate gradients for variable inference (meta-learning) and parameter estimation (continual-learning).
Resources: arXiv:2603.27134

title: Research
text:
Technical Toolkit & Methods

Core Paradigms: Deep RL, RNNs, Variational Inference, POMDPs, Bayesian beliefs, compositional generalization, latent space.
Implementation: Training and customization in PyTorch, Python scientific stack (NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, etc).

title: John Schwarcz
text:
I am a computational neuroscientist specializing in the neural mechanisms of cognitive flexibility, integrating biological, computational and theoretical perspectives for a holistic approach.
I recently completed my doctoral degree at the Edmond & Lily Safra Center for Brain Sciences (ELSC) at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem.
